id: # Feats pay career points once per profile. memory: sector or player. requiresMod: a mod id or empty.
# check: flag (default; join keys with & for all or | for any) / equals (the key holds value) / skill (the player has the skill named in flag).

# Each feat is an achievement in Achievements - Renewed (id ngp_<feat id>). shared: an achievement of another mod with the same condition; when it exists the feat pays on it and adds none of its own. hint and howTo are the achievement texts.
